account_end.equity_note: cash is a floor (open premium could go to zero). No finite upper bound is established because the open positions are not marked: at-cost is a reference only, and the upper bound is UNKNOWN, not cash + reserved.

contract_identity.note: D1 -- v3 keyed without expiry, so another series on the same strike could price or close a position
contract_identity.position_identity: index|expiry|strike|option_type, saved at the fill and used for every later quote resolution

fee_status.note: provisional because the table is labelled UNREVIEWED and its date extension is unverified at source; git cleanliness is recorded separately and is NOT the review test
fee_status.rate_value_diff_vs_reviewed: ZERO -- only version string and verified-through date

label: PROXY_SIMULATED_FILL -- no order was placed
oracle_note: window semantics, contrary confirmation and per-side fees are CALLED from the production modules, not reimplemented
proxy_assumptions: direction observations are the exports' authority history; production reads its own store, which these exports do not contain
quotes are ml_option_chain_snapshots polls, not production's dedicated broker snapshot; freshness, quantities and admission evidence are absent
equal-time ordering: decisions are processed before quote polls at the same second, and NF before BNF, declared not observed

reservation_policy.checked: before any quote lookup, so a late first quote cannot fill
reservation_policy.expires_on: the declared deadline or the end of the entry session, whichever is first; the index slot is released either way
reservation_policy.note: D2 -- v3 skipped a prior-session reservation without expiring it, so its slot stayed occupied, and tested the deadline only when no quote existed
